---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  # Drop 2018 since the dataset only covers part of that year
  filter(Year < 2018) |>
  count(Year) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = n)) +
  geom_line()
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  # Keep activities with at least 50 total incidents, then drop Unknown outcomes
  filter(n() >= 50, .by = Activity) |>
  filter(Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  count(Activity, Fatal_clean) |>
  # Reorder activities by total count so the horizontal bars are sorted
  mutate(Activity = fct_reorder(Activity, n, .fun = sum)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = Activity, fill = Fatal_clean)) +
  geom_col()
```
